correctionNotes: Use the measured AutoEq Harman correction from crinacle GRAS 43AG-7 as the baseline.
Keep AutoEq's -6.2 dB preamp for headroom; the low-frequency correction includes a large shelf due to the open/on-ear fit.
Main corrective moves are low-bass restoration, a 3.7 kHz presence lift, a 5.4 kHz glare cut, and a mild 10 kHz air shelf.
signature: Open on-ear Koss with limited seal-dependent low bass and uneven upper treble; Harman correction mainly restores bass/body, lifts presence around 3.7 kHz, and cuts a strong 5.4 kHz glare region.
source: AutoEq result from crinacle GRAS 43AG-7 over-ear measurement for Koss KPH40: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaakkopasanen/AutoEq/master/results/crinacle/GRAS%2043AG-7%20over-ear/Koss%20KPH40/Koss%20KPH40%20ParametricEQ.txt ; user also provided crinacle graph image at /Users/donahn/Downloads/KPH40.jpg. Alternate AutoEq source available: oratory1990.
